input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full: § 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); § 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness-qualified) and never to a direct competitor; § 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard to other assignments; and § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. Section 13.3 aligns licence transfers with permitted assignments. A document-wide search for "change of control" and "assign" found no hidden Vendor exit or re-pricing right; § 9.2 is a standard insolvency trigger and expressly excludes lawful reorganizations. No redline needed.
